package.name: rh56f1_hardware
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for one RH56F1 dexterous hand (6 actuators), with a transport abstraction (mock + real RS-485) so normal and error command/state paths are unit-testable without a real device. See OPENARM_RH56F1_INTEGRATION_STATUS.md Stage 4 for scope and blockers.
